claims.statement: Tom Allen said he had been matched to fight Mike McCoole on 6 March 1869.
claims.excerpt: I waa matched to fight bim on ihe 6th inst.

claims.statement: At the Broad Gauge saloon, McCoole refused to fight for the $500 balance of the deposit and insisted on $3,000 against $2,500, according to Allen.
claims.excerpt: McCoole refused to fight me for that sum and insisted on making a matcn with me for $3,000 against $2,500

claims.statement: Tom Allen challenged Mike McCoole to fight on McCoole's own ground for $2,500 a side within three months, with the money ready at William Carroll's, 510 Market Street.
claims.excerpt: give him his own ground tor $2, dollars a side, and ask no odds

claims.statement: Tom Allen said this was the second time Mike McCoole had been matched to fight him and had backed out.
claims.excerpt: This ia the second tame McCoole was matched te fight me, and the second time he has backed out

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Being astranger in the city, and not UOTE that I could raise that sum, I could not give him s decided answer.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I want no more bragging. If he can pyar: myself and Gallagher in one ripg, rurely he can whip me alone, and 82,50) is a good day's wages. So ‘‘either put ue or shat up.’’

notes: Allen's card, printed in full. The date of 8 March is read from 'sth' (could be 5th); confidence low. No bout was fought.
